newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich Airport Jan-April cargo up 5.5pct on '96.
newsitem.headline: Zurich Airport Jan-April cargo up 5.5pct on '96.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich Airport in the period January-April 1997 was up 5.5 percent on the same period last year, at 149,320 tonnes, the airport authority figures showed.

Cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at Zurich airport in the first four months of the year increased by 3.0 percent on 1996 levels to 81,041 tonnes while foreign carriers' volume was up 3.2 percent to 25,946 tonnes.
In the period in question, trucked airfreight handled at Zurich airport grew by 12.1 percent to 42,333 tonnes, the airport authority said.
Postal traffic handled at the airport totalled 6,392 tonnes - up 19.0 percent on the same period in 1996.
